description: Free and local: returns the result of a sealed_review that was still running when its call returned (status "running" and a job_id). Waits up to wait_seconds (default 45) for it to finish; if it still isn't done, call again. Nothing more is charged.

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for it to finish (default 45; keep it under 60 through a link that gives up after 60 seconds).

name: review_result
title: Get a sealed review that was still running
